ui.note: Document localized keyring setup and retry, the Linux package recommendation, and account-bound fixed Settings browser handoffs on desktop and Android. Matching Settings routes preserve the destination through browser sign-in; older servers still open their normal application page.

release.note: Prepare alpha.12 and Android code12 with the retained signing identity and unchanged protected documentation epoch.

configuration.noImpact: The Linux DEB adds a recommended Secret Service provider without changing server configuration or deployment settings. Desktop keyring setup and retry guidance are documented in apps/desktop/README.md.

deployment.note: Compose forwards GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID alongside the existing secret inputs. The Helm and AIO guides link the sign-in provider guide and show how to supply both Google values through app.extraEnv secret references or the API environment override.

native.note: Document the asynchronous five-second launcher wait, retryable spawn and non-zero exit failures, and successful handoff when a launcher remains running beyond the bound.
